assigned.title: Environment validation
assigned.acceptance: Missing required environment is reported clearly; local PostgreSQL and Redis health are documented

repo-validate.evidence: npm run check exit 0 under the pinned Node 22 runtime, including repo:validate, env:validate and test:scripts

unit.evidence: scripts/test-validate-env.mjs 27 scenarios under pinned Node 22, wired into check via test:scripts

review.evidence: CHANGES_REQUESTED by gpt-architect against head 26fd660785911f806662cdd0cf31ce920f205e54. Transcribed from the ChatGPT Project Liberty conversation, not an agent-bus message; provenance in coordination/GPT_TO_CLAUDE.md. Blocking defect: validate-env.mjs resolved only .env.local then .env while claiming to match Next.js precedence, so a value in .env.MODE.local silently overrode the file the validator inspected and the validator could pass a value the app never uses. Next.js resolves process.env, then .env.MODE.local, then .env.local, then .env.MODE, then .env, skipping .env.local under NODE_ENV=test. Non-blocking: CONTENT_RIGHTS_ENFORCEMENT carried both @optional and @default.
